entries.d6fc49ad165db06d: Its core business is the stable supply of city gas to about 470,000 customers in Niigata Prefecture. The company’s city gas customer count is 436,752, and its penetration rate against the number of households in its supply area is 94.1%. Since its founding in 1913, it has held supply areas across Niigata, Nagaoka, Kashiwazaki, Sanjo and other parts of the prefecture, and has expanded its areas by repeatedly acquiring municipal gas businesses in Niigata City, Nagaoka City, Kashiwazaki City, Mitsuke City and Ojiya City. It operates a manufacturing base at Tōkō Plant and has built a supply system based on its pipeline network.

entries.e9cc23a93b1a064f: Its basic policy is to contribute to the development of local communities through its gas business and to be a company that customers and shareholders always trust, value and choose, and its mission is “stable supply, ensuring safety, and expanding the use of natural gas.” Key initiatives include building a stable revenue structure centered on expanding gas sales volume (expanding the supply area through the acquisition of Ojiya City’s gas business, and offering the “Hokuriku Gas + Denki” gas and electricity bundle and new rate plans with repair warranties), strengthening its business base through improved seismic resistance of pipelines, remote monitoring and smart safety measures, and, toward realizing carbon neutrality by 2050, supplying carbon-offset city gas and a comprehensive cooperation agreement with Nagaoka City (concluded in March 2026).
entries.ea59382cfadf8205: This business manufactures, supplies, and sells city gas, and also undertakes construction work ordered for gas installations and sells gas appliances. The company and its consolidated subsidiary Kamohara Gas Co., Ltd. operate in supply areas including Niigata, Nagaoka, Kashiwazaki, and Sanjo. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥60,637 million, the largest among the reportable segments.
